notes.title: 12/25 sale on individual DLC items
notes.notes:
Hi all,

For everyone having difficulty getting the discounted "Final Showdown" bundle, we have individually discounted the DLC items by 45%. This was the maximum discount that Steam would allow and still show it in the territories having problems.

The sale will start 12/25/2018 10am PST.
This was the soonest we could run the sale.

You can see the items here:
https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/369230/

Thanks,
Little Orbit

notes.title: Kung Fu Panda Showdown leaving Steam and Final Sale
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Unfortunately the license for Kung Fu Panda Showdown of Legendary Legends is coming to an end.

On January 1, 2019 the time will come to remove the game from Steam. For a limited time before that happens, we have added a special Final Showdown bundle that includes the game and all the DLC for 50% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9555/Kung_Fu_Panda_Final_Showdown/

Also for the last two weeks (the maximum time we can run a sale), effective December 17th through the end of the year, you will be able to buy the main game for 50% off.

We hope that everyone enjoyed the game.

Thank you,
Little Orbit
